parsedVerdict.reasoning: CatalogueService does what an application-layer service is supposed to do. It coordinates use cases: it checks through the repository port whether a product already exists, builds the domain entity, saves it through that port and maps it to DTOs. It has no persistence code, no transport or HTTP handling and no framework logic. The rules about stock live in the domain Product entity, which the service only reads through product.availableStock. Rejecting a duplicate ID needs a repository lookup across products, so putting that check in an application service is a normal choice. No responsibility in the file belongs to a different kind of layer.
